PSD2Live

Turn a layered PSD into a moving character, then rig and animate it

Import a PSD and pick a preset to get idle motion, blinking, nodding and hair physics within minutes. Shape, rig, simulate and animate the character in one workspace.

This open source editor includes skeletons, IK, cloth and hair simulation. Export to Cubism, VTube Studio, the web, game engines or video.

A local MCP server lets agents such as Claude Code and Codex edit projects.

https://t.co/MmxdeuRZX2
